Title: Daily check-ins: schema, service, and UI
Description:
## Context
Phase 1 gap. Check-ins are the primary growth ritual; `internal/checkins` is a stub (`doc.go` only). Without them North is chat + goals, not a personal growth loop.

## Scope
- Migration: `check_ins` table (`user_id`, mood, energy, wins, challenges, notes, `related_goal_id` nullable, timestamps)
- `internal/checkins/`: repository, service, handler
- `web/` HTMX list + create form using templUI
- User-scoped queries only

## Out of scope
- ContextSource wiring (separate ticket)
- Push notifications

## Acceptance
- [ ] Authenticated user can create a check-in (mood, energy, wins, challenges, notes)
- [ ] User can list own check-in history (newest first)
- [ ] Multi-tenant isolation on all queries
- [ ] Service tests for create/list and ownership

## Architecture
- Vertical slice under `internal/checkins/`
- No business logic in handlers
- Prefer HTMX partials + templUI components

Title: Check-in ContextSource for CoachService
Description:
## Context
Coach must *use* reflections. ContextBuilder already supports `ContextSource` and `Context.CheckIns []string`.

## Scope
- Implement `checkins.ContextSource` collecting recent check-ins (e.g. last 7–14 days)
- Register source in web/worker wiring
- Prompt already renders absence; ensure non-empty formatting is readable

## Depends on
- Daily check-ins schema/service/UI

## Acceptance
- [ ] Recent check-ins appear in coach context when data exists
- [ ] Source failure degrades gracefully (does not fail the whole reply)
- [ ] Coach replies can reference yesterday’s mood/energy when present (manual or eval smoke)

## Architecture
- Implement `coach.ContextSource` only; do not edit builder core unless needed

Title: Guided check-in flow (HTMX, mobile-first)
Description:
## Context
Empty free-text check-ins die. A 30–60s structured flow drives retention.

## Scope
- Multi-step or single-page guided form: mood → energy → wins → challenges → notes
- HTMX partials; works one-handed on phone
- templUI form controls; no SPA framework

## Depends on
- Daily check-ins schema/service/UI

## Acceptance
- [ ] User completes a check-in in under ~60 seconds on mobile viewport
- [ ] Validation errors render inline
- [ ] Success returns to dashboard or history with clear confirmation

## Architecture
- Presentation only on top of existing check-in service

Title: Goal milestones and progress updates
Description:
## Context
Goals without progress feel dead. Goals CRUD exists; milestones/progress need first-class support.

## Scope
- Schema: milestones and/or progress fields on goals
- Service methods + UI on goal detail
- Timeline of progress updates

## Acceptance
- [ ] User can add/edit/complete milestones on a goal
- [ ] Progress status or % is visible on goal list/detail
- [ ] User isolation + service tests

## Architecture
- Extend `internal/goals/` slice; keep handlers thin

Title: Link check-ins to related goals
Description:
## Context
Accountability loop: reflections should optionally attach to a goal so context groups by goal.

## Scope
- Optional `related_goal_id` on check-in (if not already in A1)
- UI: goal picker on create
- ContextSource groups or labels reflections by goal title

## Depends on
- Check-ins schema + ContextSource

## Acceptance
- [ ] User can attach a check-in to an active goal
- [ ] Coach context shows goal association when set
- [ ] Detached check-ins still work

## Architecture
- FK to goals; validate ownership of goal_id

Title: Long-term memory store (profile facts)
Description:
## Context
README promises persistent memory. Today coach has conversation tail + goals/workouts, not durable profile facts (preferences, coaching style, recurring habits).

## Scope
- Migration: `user_memories` (user_id, key/category, content, pinned, source, timestamps, soft-delete)
- `internal/` slice or under users: CRUD service + simple settings UI list/edit/delete
- Never log secrets

## Acceptance
- [ ] User can view/edit/delete own memories
- [ ] Pin/exclude supported
- [ ] Isolation + service tests

## Architecture
- Domain independent of AI provider; coach reads via ContextSource in follow-up ticket

Title: Memory extraction job after conversations
Description:
## Context
Agentic memory: durable facts should be proposed from conversations, not only manual entry.

## Scope
- Worker job: after N messages or conversation idle, extract candidate facts via AI
- Store as unconfirmed or draft memories for user review
- Prompt in `internal/ai/prompts/`

## Depends on
- Long-term memory store

## Acceptance
- [ ] Job enqueues and writes candidate memories
- [ ] User can approve/edit/discard candidates
- [ ] Failures are logged; no silent data loss

## Architecture
- Jobs via existing `internal/jobs` worker; no AI in handlers

Title: Memory ContextSource and prompt policy
Description:
## Context
Memory must be bounded and trustworthy in the system prompt.

## Scope
- ContextSource that loads pinned + recent approved memories
- Render as short bullets; hard cap (token/char budget)
- Prompt policy: coach treats memory as known facts, admits gaps

## Depends on
- Long-term memory store

## Acceptance
- [ ] Memories appear in context when present
- [ ] Empty memory is silent/graceful
- [ ] Source failure does not fail coach reply

## Architecture
- Follow goals ContextSource pattern

Title: Onboarding: first-run goals and coaching style
Description:
## Context
Cold start kills OS feel. After signup, seed goals, memory, and first conversation.

## Scope
- First-run flow (3 questions): focus areas, coaching style, one near-term goal
- Creates goal(s) + initial memory facts
- Optional first coach conversation with seeded context
- Skip path available

## Depends on
- Goals + memory store

## Acceptance
- [ ] New user hits onboarding once
- [ ] Completing seeds usable coach context
- [ ] Returning users never re-see forced onboarding

## Architecture
- SSR/HTMX; state on user profile flag

Title: Dashboard as today’s OS home
Description:
## Context
Dashboard should orient the day: check-in CTA, active goals, last coach thread, next workout if any.

## Scope
- Expand `web/app/dashboard.templ` (or equivalent)
- Server-composed sections from services
- Empty states with clear CTAs

## Depends on
- Check-ins (for CTA)

## Acceptance
- [ ] Authenticated `/` or dashboard shows today’s next actions
- [ ] Links to check-in, goals, last conversation work
- [ ] Mobile layout usable

## Architecture
- Thin handler; aggregate in a small dashboard service or parallel service calls

Title: Documents: upload, storage, and metadata
Description:
## Context
Knowledge base pillar. `internal/documents` is stubbed; media/storage patterns already exist.

## Scope
- Upload PDF, Markdown, text
- Metadata list/delete UI
- Object storage via existing media patterns where possible
- User isolation

## Out of scope
- Embeddings/RAG (follow-up)

## Acceptance
- [ ] User can upload and list documents
- [ ] Delete removes storage object + DB row
- [ ] Size/type validation; clear errors

## Architecture
- `internal/documents/` slice; reuse media/storage abstractions

Title: Document extraction pipeline (worker)
Description:
## Context
Turn uploads into plain text chunks for search/LLM.

## Scope
- Job types: extract text from PDF/MD/text
- Chunk storage; status: pending/ready/failed
- UI status on document list

## Depends on
- Documents upload

## Acceptance
- [ ] Ready documents have extractable text chunks
- [ ] Failures surface in UI with retry optional
- [ ] Worker idempotent enough for re-runs

## Architecture
- `internal/jobs` worker; no extraction in HTTP request path

Title: Embeddings and search package (semantic memory)
Description:
## Context
`internal/search` is stubbed. Semantic retrieval powers knowledge context.

## Scope
- Choose store (prefer pgvector in Postgres if ops-friendly)
- Embed on document ready
- Query by user_id + text → top-k chunks
- Service tests with fake embedder if needed

## Depends on
- Document extraction

## Acceptance
- [ ] Semantic query returns only caller’s documents
- [ ] Empty index returns empty, not error
- [ ] Embedding failures mark chunks retryable

## Architecture
- AI embeddings via provider interface; no provider lock-in in services

Title: Knowledge ContextSource (RAG into coach)
Description:
## Context
Coach should cite user knowledge; never dump whole documents by default.

## Scope
- ContextSource: query search with latest user message (or conversation topic)
- Include title + short snippet; budget capped
- Wire into ContextBuilder sources

## Depends on
- Embeddings/search

## Acceptance
- [ ] Relevant docs appear as KnowledgeHits in context
- [ ] No full-document dump
- [ ] Graceful degrade if search down

## Architecture
- Fill `Context.KnowledgeHits`; follow existing source pattern

Title: Weekly review report generation
Description:
## Context
Reports are a product differentiator. `internal/reports` is stubbed.

## Scope
- Domain model + migration for reports
- Worker job: weekly review from goals, check-ins, conversations, workouts
- Prompt in `internal/ai/prompts/`
- Store markdown/structured body

## Depends on
- Check-ins (and ideally goals/workouts already exist)

## Acceptance
- [ ] Job can generate a weekly report for a user
- [ ] Report persisted and user-scoped
- [ ] Regenerable once per window (define rule)

## Architecture
- Service coordinates repos + AI; worker triggers schedule later or manual first

Title: Reports UI: view, archive, regenerate
Description:
## Context
Reviews must be consumed, not only generated.

## Scope
- List + detail pages for weekly reports
- Archive action
- Regenerate control (rate-limited)

## Depends on
- Weekly review generation

## Acceptance
- [ ] User reads full report rendered as markdown
- [ ] Archive hides from default list
- [ ] Unauthorized access returns 404/403

## Architecture
- Thin handler + templ; markdown via existing shared markdown helper

Title: Daily briefing (lightweight report)
Description:
## Context
Morning OS habit: short “today” brief from goals focus, last check-in, suggested next step.

## Scope
- Generate on demand or nightly job
- Shorter than weekly review; optional store last briefing
- Surface on dashboard

## Depends on
- Check-ins + goals context

## Acceptance
- [ ] User can open today’s briefing
- [ ] Content references real user data or admits gaps
- [ ] Cheap/fast path preferred over long essay

## Priority note
Should-ship after weekly review if capacity is tight.

Title: Conversation summarization for long threads
Description:
## Context
Keep continuity without infinite token history. Title generation already exists—extend pattern.

## Scope
- Summarize older turns; keep recent raw messages
- Store summary on conversation
- ContextBuilder uses summary + recent tail

## Acceptance
- [ ] Long threads stay within bounded context
- [ ] Summary updates periodically (job or threshold)
- [ ] User still sees full history in UI

## Architecture
- conversations service + coach ContextBuilder

Title: MCP server v0: expose North capabilities
Description:
## Context
`cmd/mcp-server` is a placeholder. North should expose business tools—not raw SQL—for Claude Desktop / agents.

## Scope
- Auth model for MCP (token/API key linked to user)
- Tools: list goals, create check-in, search knowledge, start/send coach message (read carefully for side effects)
- No internal IDs leakage beyond necessary; no raw SQL

## Depends on
- Check-ins + preferably knowledge search

## Acceptance
- [ ] External MCP client can list goals for authenticated user
- [ ] Create check-in works end-to-end
- [ ] Documented run instructions in README/docs

## Architecture
- MCP server calls the same services as HTTP; zero duplicated business logic

Title: MCP client: connect one external server (calendar or tasks)
Description:
## Context
`internal/integrations` stubbed. Bring outside world into context via one real connector.

## Scope
- MCP client connection config per user
- One integration: calendar events OR tasks
- ContextSource summarizing next 7 days / open tasks

## Acceptance
- [ ] User can connect/disconnect
- [ ] Coach context includes external summary when connected
- [ ] Failure degrades gracefully

## Architecture
- Integrations package owns client; coach only sees summary strings

Title: Tool-calling loop in CoachService
Description:
## Context
Architecture says CoachService should execute tools. Today coach is largely chat+context. Tools make North agentic.

## Scope
- Tool definitions: create_goal, log_checkin, search_docs, get_workout_plan (minimal set)
- Multi-step tool loop with budget (max rounds)
- Persist tool results into conversation/context for the reply
- Provider-agnostic tool schema on AIClient if needed

## Depends on
- Check-ins (+ docs search if search_docs included)

## Acceptance
- [ ] Model can log a check-in via tool and confirm in reply
- [ ] Model can create a goal via tool
- [ ] Loop terminates cleanly; errors returned to model
- [ ] Service tests with fake AI client

## Architecture
- Tools call services, not repos/SQL
- No provider-specific tool APIs in domain

Title: Confirm side-effect tools in UI
Description:
## Context
Trust: writes from the agent need explicit confirmation (or clearly safe defaults).

## Scope
- UX for pending tool confirmation (HTMX/Alpine)
- Policy: which tools auto-run vs confirm
- Audit log of tool executions optional but preferred

## Depends on
- Tool-calling loop

## Acceptance
- [ ] Destructive or state-changing tools can require confirm
- [ ] User can reject; coach continues without applying
- [ ] Confirmed tools apply exactly once

## Architecture
- Keep policy in service; UI only presents pending actions

Title: Scheduled coach nudges (worker)
Description:
## Context
Accountability without waiting for the user to open chat.

## Scope
- Rules: e.g. no check-in in 2 days; goal deadline approaching
- Worker evaluates and stores in-app notifications
- Dashboard/bell UI for notifications
- Optional email/push later (out of scope)

## Depends on
- Check-ins + settings timezone preferred

## Acceptance
- [ ] Nudges created by schedule for eligible users
- [ ] User can dismiss/read notifications
- [ ] No spam: dedupe window defined

## Architecture
- jobs worker; pure rules in service

Title: Reflection session mode
Description:
## Context
Structured coaching product: coach asks 3–5 questions, ends with summary + optional memory write.

## Scope
- Session type or conversation flag `reflection`
- Prompt + flow for Q&A rounds
- End: summary stored; optional memory candidates

## Depends on
- Memory store preferred

## Acceptance
- [ ] User can start a reflection session from UI
- [ ] Session ends with written summary user can see
- [ ] Optional “save to memory” action

## Architecture
- Still CoachService; different prompt/mode, not a second brain

Title: Decision journal
Description:
## Context
Personal growth staple: capture decision, options, later outcome; searchable for coach.

## Scope
- CRUD decision entries
- Optional outcome field later
- ContextSource when user discusses related topics (simple keyword/recent first)

## Acceptance
- [ ] User can log and list decisions
- [ ] Coach can see recent decisions in context when source enabled

## Priority note
Nice-to-have after must-ship agentic core.

Title: Simple consistency metrics (check-in streak, 7d goal activity)
Description:
## Context
Light motivation on dashboard without gamification spam.

## Scope
- Compute check-in streak
- Count goal-related activity last 7 days
- Show on dashboard

## Depends on
- Check-ins

## Acceptance
- [ ] Streak correct across timezone boundary (use user timezone when available)
- [ ] Hidden or zero-state when no data (no shame UX)

## Priority
Should/nice after core loop works.

Title: Fitness summary interface + Strava import
Description:
## Context
README Phase 3. Workouts exist in-app; external fitness summaries still stubbed in `internal/fitness`.

## Scope
- Fitness provider interface producing summaries
- Strava OAuth + activity sync job
- Store normalized summaries only for coach

## Acceptance
- [ ] User connects Strava
- [ ] Recent activities summarized for coach consumption
- [ ] Disconnect revokes tokens safely

## Architecture
- Coach never sees raw Strava JSON

Title: Activity summary ContextSource
Description:
## Context
Wire fitness summaries into coach context (last 7 days volume/recovery hints).

## Depends on
- Strava import / fitness summaries

## Acceptance
- [ ] Connected users get fitness section in context
- [ ] Disconnected users unaffected
- [ ] Graceful degrade on API failure

Title: Messaging adapter interface into CoachService
Description:
## Context
One brain, many mouths. `internal/messaging` is stubbed.

## Scope
- `InboundMessage` / `OutboundMessage` interfaces
- Adapter maps platform → CoachService
- No platform-specific business logic

## Acceptance
- [ ] Unit test with fake adapter round-trip to CoachService
- [ ] Shared conversation identity strategy documented (link account)

## Architecture
- Messaging package is infrastructure; services own logic

Title: Telegram bot as first messaging channel
Description:
## Context
Highest-ROI non-web channel for a personal coach.

## Scope
- Telegram bot webhook/long-poll
- Account linking flow (web code → telegram user)
- Send/receive via messaging adapter → CoachService
- Same memory as web

## Depends on
- Messaging adapter interface

## Acceptance
- [ ] Linked user can chat with North on Telegram
- [ ] Messages appear in web conversation history (or documented dual-store strategy)
- [ ] Unlinked users get link instructions only

## Architecture
- Zero coaching logic in Telegram package

Title: Mobile-first PWA polish for check-in and chat
Description:
## Context
Bridge before native iOS. Chat already improved for phone; extend to check-in + installability.

## Scope
- Web app manifest + service worker basics if missing
- Check-in + chat one-handed usability pass
- Safe areas, sticky composer, large tap targets

## Acceptance
- [ ] Installable on iOS/Android Safari/Chrome
- [ ] Check-in + chat usable without desktop

## Priority
Should-ship polish; not a substitute for growth loop features.

Title: User data export and account delete
Description:
## Context
Trust baseline before strangers use the product.

## Scope
- Export JSON (or zip) of user data: profile, goals, check-ins, conversations, memories, documents metadata
- Account delete with cascade of user-owned rows + storage objects
- Confirm UX

## Acceptance
- [ ] Export completes for account with sample data
- [ ] Delete removes sessions and personal data
- [ ] Cannot access deleted account resources

## Architecture
- Service-level orchestration; careful transaction boundaries

Title: Rate limits on AI and uploads
Description:
## Context
Cost and abuse control for a real multi-user OS.

## Scope
- Per-user rate limits: coach messages, uploads, report regenerations
- Clear UX errors when limited
- Config via env

## Acceptance
- [ ] Exceeding limit returns friendly error, not 500
- [ ] Limits documented for operators

## Architecture
- Middleware or service guards; prefer simple token bucket/counters in Redis or DB

Title: Expand AI eval harness for grounding cases
Description:
## Context
`internal/ai/eval` exists. Feature-ready needs golden cases for growth OS behaviors.

## Scope
- Cases: goals appear in context; no hallucinated check-ins; RAG citations when docs exist; memory respect
- Runnable in CI or documented live test tags
- Fake provider fixtures where possible

## Acceptance
- [ ] Eval suite covers ≥4 growth-OS scenarios
- [ ] Failures are actionable (which case/assertion)

## Architecture
- Keep evals out of unit-test default path if flaky/live

Title: Empty states and “what should I do next?” CTAs
Description:
## Context
Activation: new users must never stare at blank chat/dashboard.

## Scope
- Empty states for goals, check-ins, chat, documents, reports
- Primary CTA per surface
- Optional coach-suggested first message chips

## Acceptance
- [ ] Fresh account has guided next step on dashboard and chat
- [ ] Copy is product-quality, not lorem

## Architecture
- Templ components; no new frameworks

Title: Settings: timezone, coaching tone, notification prefs
Description:
## Context
Context already has LocalTime. Users need editable profile that affects prompts and schedules.

## Scope
- Settings page: timezone, coaching tone, notification toggles
- Persist on user profile
- Coach prompt uses tone; jobs use timezone

## Acceptance
- [ ] Changing timezone updates local-time in coach context
- [ ] Tone reflected in system prompt section
- [ ] Defaults sensible for new users

## Architecture
- users service fields; prompt builder reads profile

Title: Observability for coach, context sources, and jobs
Description:
## Context
Context sources already fail soft—need visibility in production.

## Scope
- Structured logs/metrics: coach latency, per-source errors, job failures, AI token usage if available
- Request IDs already exist—propagate into coach/jobs

## Acceptance
- [ ] Operator can identify which ContextSource failed from logs
- [ ] Job failures alertable via log patterns
- [ ] No secrets in logs

## Architecture
- slog structured fields; optional Prometheus later

Title: [Later] Discord messaging channel
Description:
## Context
Phase 3 multi-platform. Do after Telegram adapter patterns are proven.

## Out of scope for feature-ready v1
Ship only if Telegram path is stable.

## Acceptance
- Same adapter interface as Telegram; account linking; CoachService only.

Title: [Later] WhatsApp messaging channel
Description:
## Context
Phase 3. Higher compliance/ops cost than Telegram—defer past strangers-ready v1.

## Acceptance
- Adapter + linking + CoachService parity with Telegram.

Title: [Later] Native iOS companion, widgets, Live Activities, Watch
Description:
## Context
README Phase 4. Explicitly not required for feature-ready web/agentic OS.

## Notes
Keep as placeholder epic; do not pull into current milestone until strangers use web/PWA.

Title: [Later] Apple Health / Garmin / Fitbit providers
Description:
## Context
After Strava summary interface exists. Interchangeable fitness providers producing summaries only.

## Depends on
- Fitness summary interface
